<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, corresponds to a cycloaddition where a C‑C bond is formed and a C‑O bond is broken, and the forward reaction loses the functional groups “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”. Using the correct functional‑group names from the allowed list, we search the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
